# awattsdev

> Andrew Watts, freelance software developer based in Civray (Vienne 86), Nouvelle-Aquitaine, France. Builds custom web applications, SaaS products and AI integrations for businesses in Sud Vienne, Poitiers, Angoulême and across France, the UK and Europe.

## Services

- **Custom Web Applications & SaaS**: Web applications, ecommerce platforms and SaaS products built around how a business actually works. Admin dashboards, payments (PayPal, Stripe), multi-language storefronts, integrations with existing tools. Built with Next.js, React, Go and PostgreSQL. The client owns the code. Quoted per project.
- **AI Integration & Automation**: AI features and automation built into business tools: document processing, drafting, data extraction and workflow automation. Quoted per project.
- **Websites**: Custom-coded professional websites for small businesses from €650, one-time payment, no monthly fees. Bilingual English/French. Delivered in 10 days from content receipt.
- **AI Workshops**: 60-minute hands-on Claude AI workshop for small business owners. €50 per person.
- **IT Support**: On-site or remote tech support for businesses and individuals. Hardware, software, email and network. Hourly, no contracts.

## Work

- SiliconSoup: custom online shop replacing WooCommerce, with admin dashboard, product options, PayPal checkout and verified reviews (Go + Vite).
- Gard'Apis: ecommerce store for a French beekeeping brand, 6 languages, hosted for around €13/month.
- einvoicer: SaaS for EU-compliant e-invoicing (Factur-X, Peppol BIS 3.0), integrated with the French Super PDP network.

## Location & Service Areas

Based in Civray (Vienne 86), Nouvelle-Aquitaine, France. Serving Civray, Sud Vienne, Poitiers, Angoulême, Vienne (86), Charente (16) and Nouvelle-Aquitaine in person, and clients across France, the UK and Europe remotely.
